newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA TO USE WORLD BANK CASH FOR HEATING METERS.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA TO USE WORLD BANK CASH FOR HEATING METERS.

text.p: The World Bank has agreed with Bulgaria to transfer $12 million from an existing loan to supply 17,000 heating meters in residential buildings, the energy ministry said on Wednesday.
A ministry statement said it would use $12 million from a $98 million loan extended to the construction ministry last year for the modernisation of the water system.

Another project for supplying individual heating meters in households will be funded by the World Bank, the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development and the European Union's Phare programme, the statement said.
People who up to now have paid a flat rate for their heating will now be able to pay according to consumption.

Heating was heavily subsidised during the communist era but soaring prices mean Bulgarians are keen to save power this winter. More than 12 percent of Bulgarians whose homes are linked to central heating have asked for supply to be reduced.
